cross_references.note: Barker expands Greenman's design defect prong into dual test (consumer expectations + risk-utility). Must be read together.
VICP preemption limits Greenman strict liability against vaccine MANUFACTURERS for design defects. Does NOT apply to Walgreens as administering party.
Greenman intentionally separated strict liability tort from warranty contract. Both theories may be pled simultaneously. COM §2314 adds contractual warranty track.
SIRVA against Walgreens is primarily a negligent administration claim owned by CA_Medical_Malpractice_Litigator. This standard covers device defect layer only.
RedJag stripped vehicle parts: VEH §11713 dealer fraud runs concurrent with Greenman manufacturing defect theory for the vehicle as delivered.
